what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1982?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1982 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (168 pages) was searched for gross, wages and salary; the only hits are the line `Special Details Wages` (receipts, p118; payments) and department salary lines inside the accountant's schedule (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1982 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates for fiscal 1983?
why: `salary-schedule` reads Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1982 annual town report names the Salary and Wage Classification Schedule only in prose (p25, the Personnel Committee: `the Salary and Wage Classification Schedule as presented in the Finance Committee Report`) and prints no schedule; searched for schedule, classification and salary (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the April 3, 1982 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1982, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1982 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as liability lines of the balance sheet (p124-125), and the School Department's own special accounts (p104-108); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1982 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1983 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1982 report prints no capital plan: capital items appear only as appropriation balances on the balance sheet (p125, p130) and special articles (p158). Searched for capital (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Finance Committee's FY1983 report listing capital articles.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1983?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables from the 1987-2010 reports and FY2011 onward. The 1982 report prints the valuation and tax rate only as label/value lines on p3 (real estate $186,251,057, personal property $6,498,650, tax rate $19.40) and in prose (p12, revaluation certified at 106%); no table by class, no overlay, no new growth. Searched valuation, abstract, overlay, tax rate (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Assessors' FY1983 tax rate recapitulation filed with the Department of Revenue.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1982, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1982 report prints the receipts line `Sealing Fees` 181.00 in the statement of receipts (p117) and the Sealer's salary; no device counts and no fee schedule. Searched weights, sealer, sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1982 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: Which payees received over $4,000 from the town in fiscal 1982?
why: `report-vendor-payments` holds the contracts-over-$4,000 list from the 1986 report. The 1982 report prints no such list; the whole text was searched for `4,000`, contracts, and `in excess of` (only the tax exemption `$4,000 valuation` and one budget line hit) (sources/data/report-tables/1982/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1982 accounts-payable detail by vendor.
